text: Notice: The Maple Street Repair Cafe will hold this Saturday’s session at the Community Hall instead of the library. Volunteers, please arrive at 9:30 a.m. to help set up. Visitors are welcome from 10:00 a.m. Bring your small broken household items, and we’ll do our best to help repair them.
task: Write a notice explaining that a fictional neighborhood repair cafe will move its Saturday session from the library to the community hall. Volunteers should arrive at 9:30 and visitors at 10.
